Seven is the community-created term to refer to the seventh permanent party member of Xenoblade Chronicles. The term arose due to a desire to mask a major spoiler, and continues to be used despite some official material (some for the game itself, some for crossovers) treating the matter as an open secret. As per this wiki's spoiler policy, while some effort will be made to use this term if feasible, perfect secrecy cannot be guaranteed. It is inevitable that something will spoil the issue in the interest of correct and complete information. To continue to the page on the subject, click here.

Kaori Tanaka, known more commonly by her pen name, Soraya Saga, is a Japanese freelance writer, designer, and artist. She served as a lead writer for Xenogears and Xenosaga Episode I, and an assistant author for Xenosaga Episode II and Xenosaga: Pied Piper. She also served as a guest character designer for Xenoblade Chronicles 2 as the designer of Gorg. She is married to Tetsuya Takahashi. In December of 2025, Saga's Blogspot page clarified her retirement from video game writing due to family circumstances.

Super Heal is an enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles usable by strong Telethia. It heals the user for 4% of its max HP every 2 seconds. Since enemies tend to have large HP pools, and the only uses of it apply an infinite duration, this makes it practically impossible to kill the foe without first getting rid of the aura via , Mind Blast, or a .

Superweapons are a special class of Skell weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are obtained by being crafted at the AM Terminal, and their schematics are obtained either via story progress, mission completion, or found in Treasure Boxes. Superweapons typically deal much more than non-superweapons, have an extremely long cooldown (120 seconds at base), and consume more than average. Superweapons have "USP" as part of their naming scheme in lieu of the "M"/"XM"/"XXM"/"R"/"XR"/"XXR" seen on non-superweapons. Superweapons can be grouped based upon the Skell Art they perform. Typically, each such group contains three superweapons: a level 30 version, a level 50 version, and a level 60 version.
